title: Shared small-coefficient inclusions and their integral structural maps
statement: For a prime ell, an algebraic closure Omega/Q_ell and finite subextensions E≤L, present the existing size-transported coefficient inclusion [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients] with the semiring structures projected from the existing coefficient fields. The map is exactly the existing inclusion. Its identity and composition laws are the existing inclusion laws at those same explicit structures. No field, inclusion or scalar transition is newly selected. The shared integral unitor and associator are exactly scalar completion unit/composition conjugated by those same inclusion equalities; the original public names are aliases, so no structural map changes.

source.place: Finite-coefficient models of the automorphism pullback family; an interface presentation of the existing coefficient inclusions, not a new mathematical assertion.

proof.text: Define the inclusion as the existing coefficientInclusion, with its AlgHom semiring parameters explicitly the projections of the existing Field instances. Reuse coefficientInclusion_laws directly for identity and composition. This is a definitionally equal presentation and does not alter any coefficient map. Define the shared integral adapters by the existing sfIntegralScalarUnit and sfIntegralScalarComp followed by eqToIso of the corresponding inclusion law. These are exactly the original adapter bodies, without a new choice.

proof_origin.place: S5 implementation of the existing finite-coefficient model interface; parent scalar-coherence clauses
